description: This file defines the AssumeRoleCredentialProvider class, which provides AWS credentials via assuming a role using the STS client. It includes methods to initialize with configuration, load credentials asynchronously, and handle errors.

classes.name: AssumeRoleCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider that obtains AWS credentials by assuming a role via STS.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with client and assume role parameters.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads assume role credentials asynchronously and handles success or failure.
